newsitem.title: USA: Spatialight says stock removed from Nasdaq.
newsitem.headline: Spatialight says stock removed from Nasdaq.

text.p: Spatialight Inc on Wednesday said Nasdaq has removed its stock from the Nasdaq smallcap system and effective today, it will be traded on the Nasdaq electronic bulletin board system.

In a statement, the company said Nasdaq's standards committee determined it did not meet minimum guidelines for total assets and at the time of the company's Nasdaq hearing, its stock price was below the $1.00 per share guideline.
The company said it expects to satisfy the Nasdaq requirements within the next two quarters.
